narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Spider Silk Slippers, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: Are these my new boots? <Kixxle looks very excited, but it fades immediately upon setting his eyes upon them.> Ah. I thought I had cancelled the order for slippers once I realized how foolish it would be to trudge around a swamp with my toes hanging out. I ordered a new pair of proper boots too, but they still haven't arrived yet. Oh well, pleasure doing business with you. I'll keep these for later!
